hero_pattern: Full-field expressive identity mark over a high-contrast graphic treatment.
concept_application_progression: Moves from core identity cues into increasingly specific physical and digital applications.
image_scale_rhythm: Alternates broad montage scenes with focused object or detail frames.
page_density: Dense application groups are separated by narrow copy or graphic transition modules.
alternation_pattern: Graphic fields and warm photographic mockups alternate throughout the sequence.
caption_behavior: Small utility labels sit at edges while display messages remain dominant.
mockup_grouping: Related packaging or touchpoint variants are grouped to expose consistency and controlled variation.
ending_pattern: Spatial storefront evidence resolves into minimal graphic separators.
